title: Do not touch: support Finish3D operations

body:
The "Do not touch" group of the Geometry tab (Boundaries) does not work on a Finish3D operation. The group shows only the note "'Do not touch' is supported on 2D Offset and 3D Pocket operations only so far". There is no "Pick protected" button. The maintainer asked for "do not touch" on operations, in his words: "the calculation should avoid to gouge them at all costs" (#2055).

Found during the work on #3335. Refs #2055. Refs #3335.

## What to do

1. Add `OpType::Finish3D` to `do_not_touch_applies` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs`).
2. Make the Finish3D generator keep the full tool (flutes, shank and holder) clear of each protected face and edge, by the clearance. This includes the cutting moves, the lead moves, the link moves and the plunges.
3. If the generator cannot keep clear, refuse the operation or mark it "incomplete". The diagnostic names the item. The post is blocked.
4. The verify check and the post gate already check the protected items. Make sure that they read the Finish3D moves.

## Safety

This work is under the safety floor: it changes the toolpath and the posted G-code of a Finish3D operation that has protected items. A Finish3D operation without protected items must give the same toolpath as before. Pin that.

## Done means

- The Boundary group of a Finish3D operation shows "Pick protected", and a viewport click adds a face or an edge row.
- A test with a protected face next to the cut shows that no move comes nearer than the clearance.
- A test with a protected face that the cut cannot avoid shows the refusal with the item named, and a blocked post.
- A test shows that a Finish3D operation without protected items gives the same toolpath.
